cases.name: Johanna Mae "Jo" Gould
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Johanna (Jo) grew up in Lincoln Park, MI and graduated from Lincoln Park High School.

She worked several years for Security Bank & Trust in Lincoln Park, MI before starting a family with her husband William (Bill) Gould. They lived in Southgate, MI, Alpena, MI and finally settled in Mission, TX.

Johanna was well loved and respected by her family and friends. She had a passion for crafts which include her main love of quilting."
